service.description: The expense claims the caller reads: their own (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE; mine for those alone), their live reports' at the line's employers (PEOPLE_TEAM_VIEW), an HR reader's (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW) and a payroll reader's (PAYROLL_VIEW) employers'; with toDecide, the claims whose step waiting the caller decides now (PEOPLE_REQUEST_APPROVE). Narrowed to a person, an employer, a business state and the days made (fromDate through thruDate). Newest first, paged (an export, pageNoLimit, up to 2000); each with the person, employer, project, purpose, day, currency and total, the business state, the stage (draft, waiting, returned, approved: with finance, finance approved, paid, refused, cancelled), the route and whether the caller decides it. Refuses a caller with none of the five permissions (PERMISSION_DENIED).

An expense claim the caller reads (the claimant, their manager at the employer, an HR or payroll reader of the employer, an approver of its step; another, or an invoice that is no claim, is refused as missing, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE): the claim as find#Claims shows it with its department, description, revision and the decider's reason when returned or refused; its lines (type, description, day, quantity, amount, the tax included, merchant, receipt, source and whether it waits for review); its approval (each step with who decides, the decisions); the finance state and settlement (the invoice's state, applied and unpaid, each payment applied to it, an advance or a reimbursement, and the route reserved); the claimant's approved advances still outstanding at the employer; and what the caller may do: canEdit, canSubmit and canCancel (the claimant or an HR editor, a draft or returned claim), canDecide (an approver of the step waiting), canWithdraw (the claimant or who made it, while it waits).

A draft (or returned) claim's header changed by the claimant or an HR editor of the employer (PERMISSION_DENIED for another reader; a claim waiting or decided is CLAIM_LOCKED): purpose, description, the day it is dated, a project the claimant works on (PROJECT_UNAVAILABLE; empty clears it) and, while it has no line, the currency (CURRENCY_LOCKED). revision, the claim's revision read, refuses a stale write (REVISION_CHANGED). A claim is made by mantle.account.InvoiceServices.create#ProjectExpenseInvoice with expenseClaim.

A line of a draft (or returned) claim added (no invoiceItemSeqId), changed or removed (remove) by the claimant or an HR editor: the expense type (an ItemExpense-family type, EXPENSE_TYPE_INVALID), the description (DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED), the day (DATE_FUTURE), the quantity (1 by default, QUANTITY_INVALID), the amount (positive and to the currency's precision, AMOUNT_INVALID, CURRENCY_PRECISION), the tax it includes (TAX_INVALID beyond the line), the merchant and a receipt file (a photo, a PDF or a text file of at most 10 MB, RECEIPT_INVALID, RECEIPT_TOO_LARGE), kept as the invoice's receipt content. Saving a line is the claimant's review of it: a line from mail or chat, or with values read from its receipt, no longer waits. Refuses as store#Claim does.

Values proposed from a receipt for a line of a claim the caller changes ("Read receipt", design §9): the text given (receiptText, typed or pasted), else the text of the line's receipt file (a PDF or a text file; a photo's text is not read), passed to org.moqui.agent.AiTaskServices.run#Extract, which wraps it as untrusted. Nothing is saved: the proposal (itemDate, amount, currencyUomId, merchantName, taxAmount, description) is shown for the claimant to review and save with store#ClaimItem. available false, with a message, when there is no text or no model answers. Refuses as store#ClaimItem does.

A draft (or returned) claim sent for business approval by the claimant or an HR editor: it has lines (LINES_REQUIRED), none waiting for review (LINES_TO_REVIEW), each with an amount (AMOUNT_INVALID); its invoice is received (InvoiceReceived) and a People approval of kind PakExpenseClaim is asked (PeopleExpenseApproval to the first step's approvers: the claimant's manager unless a rule says otherwise; never the claimant or who asked; with none it waits). receiptsMissing counts the lines without a receipt (not refused). A claim already waiting answers as it is (repeated). Refuses another reader (PERMISSION_DENIED), a claim decided or cancelled (CLAIM_LOCKED).

An expense claim decided, under its lock. approve: the step waiting, through PeopleApprovalServices.record#Decision at the claim's revision (sourceRevision from a notice); the last approval is its business approval, which leaves the invoice received for finance (never InvoiceApproved). return (a reason): back to the claimant to correct and submit again. refuse (a reason): refused, its invoice cancelled. withdraw: the claimant or who made it takes back a claim waiting (a draft again, its approval superseded). cancel: the claimant or HR cancels a draft or returned claim (its invoice cancelled). One who reads nothing of it is answered as for a missing one (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). A decision retried answers the first (repeated). Refuses: DECISION_INVALID, NOT_YOURS, NOT_PENDING and record#Decision's refusals (NOT_APPROVER, SELF_APPROVAL, ALREADY_DECIDED, SOURCE_CHANGED, REASON_REQUIRED).

parameter.name: decision
parameter.description: approve (the default), return, refuse, withdraw or cancel

service.description: The PeopleExpenseApproval topic's approve service, which approve#NotificationMessage calls as the user deciding the notice: decide#Claim at the claim and revision in the message (a notice of an earlier revision is refused); refuses a notice of another record (SOURCE_INVALID).
The PeopleExpenseApproval topic's refuse service, with the reason (the topic requires one): as approve#Claim, the claim refused and its invoice cancelled.
A receipt of a claim the caller reads (get#Claim's readers; another, or a file of another invoice, is refused as missing): its location and name, for the screen to send.
The receipts of a claim the caller reads, for its evidence bundle (design §15): each a path in the bundle (receipts/line-NN-...) and its location. The screen adds the claim's printed PDF.

What the caller's own new claim or advance offers (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE; no party parameter): their current employments (the employer and its currency) and the projects they work on, none for a caller without self-service; and the expense types (ItemExpense's family), a closed list for anyone changing a claim.

Whether the caller has a current employment of their own to claim under (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE and a person; no party parameter): the condition-service of the quick create New claim, which the shell asks on each page load. Answers false for anyone else.

An approved claim taken by its settlement route, or released by it (design §9: one route, the original invoice settled once). EcrPayroll: a payroll editor of the employer (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT; PERMISSION_DENIED, another employer's claim RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) reserves it for a pay run named by reference (impl-people P27), while its invoice is received; EcrPayable: INVOICE_APPROVE in the organization, as finance's approve#Payable reserves it. A claim reserved for the other route is refused (CLAIM_RESERVED), one not business-approved too (CLAIM_NOT_APPROVED); taken again by its own route it answers as it is (repeated). release frees the same route's reservation while the invoice is not approved for payment (CLAIM_SETTLED).

The employee advances the caller reads (as find#Claims: their own, a manager's reports', an HR or payroll reader's employers', or with toDecide those they decide now), narrowed by a person, an employer and a state; or, with finance and organizationPartyId, the organization's approved advances for finance to pay and apply (a finance reader of the organization: ACCOUNTING_VIEW, ACCOUNTING_ADMIN or PAYABLE_VIEW; ORGANIZATION_DENIED, PERMISSION_DENIED). Newest first, paged; each with the person, employer, purpose, the amount asked, delivered (its payment once delivered or confirmed), applied (to claims, or returned) and outstanding (delivered less applied, never a balance kept), the state and stage (waiting, to pay, paid and outstanding, settled, refused, withdrawn), the payment and the claims it was applied to.

An advance asked: by the employee for their own current employment (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE; the one named, else their only one, EMPLOYMENT_REQUIRED), or by an HR editor of the employer for an employee's (partyRelationshipId; another reader PERMISSION_DENIED, another employment RECORD_UNAVAILABLE): the purpose (PURPOSE_REQUIRED), the amount (positive, AMOUNT_INVALID) in the employer's currency unless another is named (CURRENCY_REQUIRED), when it is needed and when it should be settled (DATES_INVALID). Sent for a People approval of kind PakAdvance (PeopleAdvanceApproval). A retry with the same operationKey answers the first (repeated).

An advance decided, under its lock: approve or refuse (with a reason) the step waiting, through PeopleApprovalServices.record#Decision at the advance's revision; the last approval makes it payable by finance (approval to advance is not payment). withdraw: the person or who asked, while it waits. One who reads nothing of it is answered as for a missing one. A decision retried answers the first. Refuses as decide#Claim does.

The PeopleAdvanceApproval topic's approve service (approve#NotificationMessage calls it as the user): decide#Advance at the advance and revision in the message; refuses a notice of another record (SOURCE_INVALID).
The PeopleAdvanceApproval topic's refuse service, with the reason: as approve#Advance, the advance refused.

Finance pays an approved advance (PAYMENT_EDIT in its organization: PERMISSION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_DENIED; NOT_APPROVED before approval): a prepayment (PtPrePayment) from the employer to the employee for the advance's amount and currency, delivered on effectiveDate (now by default) by the instrument named, through mantle.account.PaymentServices.create#Payment (posted as Accounting posts it); the payment is the advance's. One paid already answers its payment (repeated).

Finance applies a paid advance to the employee's claim at the same employer (PAYMENT_EDIT in the organization; CLAIM_INVALID for another's): the claim's invoice approved for payment (CLAIM_NOT_FINANCE_APPROVED), in the advance's currency (CURRENCY_MISMATCH), at most what is outstanding of the advance and unpaid of the claim (the amount given, AMOUNT_EXCEEDS beyond it, else the lesser; NOTHING_OUTSTANDING, CLAIM_SETTLED), through mantle.account.PaymentServices.apply#InvoicePayment. Answers what was applied and what is outstanding after.

The createExpenseLine action of the mail client's rules (org.moqui.mail.EmailClientServices.run#EmailRules, through the EmailRuleAction enumeration ErActCreateExpenseLine; impl-people F65), run with authorization off, so it checks itself what it does. The claimant is the person whose current work address (EmailWork) sent the message and who is employed now (value names the employer when they have several); the message's files (else its text) become the receipts of one draft line on their open draft claim with that employer, or a new draft, for the claimant to review: never submitted by mail, so a forged sender adds a draft line at most. A message makes one line once (answered again, created false); a sender who is no one's work address, or several people's, or not employed there adds nothing (logged).

parameter.name: value
parameter.description: The employer, for a sender employed by several

service.description: "Add to my claim" from a chat message (the create-from of the IronStone chat's message actions, kind claimLine): a message of the caller's own (NOT_YOURS) in a room they read (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE; an end-to-end encrypted room's, ROOM_ENCRYPTED, whose text the server does not have) becomes a draft line, its files the receipts, on their open draft claim for their one current employment (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE; NOT_EMPLOYED, EMPLOYMENT_REQUIRED), or a new draft, to review. A message makes one line once (created false).
